description_en: Submits an SQL query and exports a result set
description_zh: 调用SubmitResultExportJob接口提交SQL查询并导出结果集
kebab_example: aliyun adb submit-result-export-job --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-cluster-id amv-bp10a0ng21t50000 --schema tpch_oss --sql SELECT_0_FROM_fotor_com_datastore_resource_._fotor_ai_create_task_where_date_=_2023-05-13_LIMIT_10 --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SubmitResultExportJob

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html接口查看集群的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Lakehouse Edition cluster.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Lakehouse Edition clusters within a region
parameters.help_zh:
AnalyticDB MySQL湖仓版（3.0）集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口查询目标地域中所有AnalyticDB MySQL湖仓版（3.0）集群的集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The engine that is used to run the result set export job. Set the value to XIHE
parameters.help_zh: 任务执行的引擎，目前只支持XIHE
parameters.name: engine

parameters.help_en: The name of the resource group that runs the result set export job
parameters.name: resource_group

parameters.help_en: The SQL statement that is used in the result set export job. You can specify only SELECT statements. If you specify other SQL statements, the request fails
parameters.help_zh: 仅支持执行SELECT语句，其他SQL语句会导致接口调用失败
parameters.name: sql

parameters.help_en: The type of the result set export job
parameters.name: export_type

Data.description_en: The ID of the result set export job

HttpStatusCode.description_en: The response code. The status code 200 indicates that the request was successful
HttpStatusCode.description_zh: HTTP请求返回的响应状态码，200表示请求发送成功

Message.description_en:
The returned message. Valid values:

If the request was successful, an OK message is returned.
If the request failed, an error message is returned
Message.description_zh:
调用结果的附加信息。取值说明：
请求正常，返回OK。                                
请求异常，返回具体异常错误码

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true
false
Success.description_zh:
调用是否成功，取值说明：
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
